items.title: London ABAs Quarter-Finals: J. Smith vs T. O'Connor (Copper Box)
items.body: A disciplined display of counter-punching and ring generalship secured a unanimous decision victory through three fast-paced rounds.

items.title: Metropolitan Youth Championship: K. Vance vs D. Miller (York Hall)
items.body: A dominant performance culminating in a second-round stoppage following relentless pressure and a clean combination to the body.

items.title: Club Home Show vs Finchley ABC: M. Taylor vs S. Jenkins
items.body: An absolute barnburner in front of a packed home crowd. Taylor dug deep in the third round to edge a split decision.

items.title: National Amateur Open: L. Harper vs R. Patel (Birmingham)
items.body: A tough, educational battle against a seasoned national finalist. Harper showed incredible heart but dropped a close points decision.

items.title: London Novice Box Cup: A. Diallo vs B. Murphy (Alexandra Palace)
items.body: Diallo utilized a sharp jab and superior reach to control the center of the ring, taking a clear unanimous points win in his tournament opener.

items.title: Inter-Club Sparring Showcase: Skills Exhibition
items.body: Great developmental rounds hosted at our gym with visiting fighters. Valuable technical experience gained by our junior development squad.

items.title: Southern England Development Bouts: J. Smith vs C. Davies
items.body: Referee waved off the contest in the final round after a sustained flurry of hooks trapped the opponent in a neutral corner.

items.title: Capital Elite Night: E. Johnson vs M. Ali (York Hall)
items.body: An incredible clash of styles where neither boxer could pull away. Judges scored it even after three rounds of non-stop action.

items.title: North London Championship: K. Vance vs P. O'Neill
items.body: Vance bounced back with brilliant footwork and swift check-hooks, keeping his opponent guessing all night to take the gold medal.

items.title: Southpaw Showdown Invitational: L. Harper vs J. Walsh
items.body: Tactical masterclass dealing with a tricky southpaw stance. Harper adjusted his angles cleanly in rounds two and three to seal the win.
